Journey from a curious learner to a QA engineer at InnovateTech Consulting has been a blend of trial, mentorship, and relentless curiosity. Early days were spent unraveling the logic behind software systems, gradually shifting from theoretical knowledge to hands-on problem-solving. The transition into testing wasn’t immediate—it required patience, iterative learning, and a mindset focused on empathy for end-users. Today, the goal is to bridge gaps between development and quality, ensuring solutions are reliable and user-centric.  

Current Focus revolves around collaborating with cross-functional teams to design robust testing frameworks, streamline CI/CD pipelines, and deliver insights that elevate product quality. While the role is evolving, the core mission remains: to turn ambiguity into clarity and uncertainty into confidence.  

Skills Highlight includes a working knowledge of API testing, CI/CD integration, and automation tools like Selenium/Playwright. Proficiency in Python and JavaScript supports both scripting and collaboration with development teams. Familiarity with test strategy design and unit testing ensures alignment with project goals.  

I’d love to connect and exchange ideas on refining testing practices or exploring new ways to enhance software reliability. Let’s grow together.
